parent_objective: audit M2428 measured-result reindex before deciding whether to synthesize, repair c04 coverage, reassess scenario quality, or stop
blocked_by: M2428 matched c01/c02/c03 slices remain offtrack-dominated
M2428 explicitly excludes c04 because M2426 has zero matched effective candidates
continuing artifact-only reindexing without a scenario-quality decision would be local search
supersedes: direct candidate-family ranking from M2428 aggregates
current-sim verdict from matched-subset reindex alone
another reindex artifact before route synthesis or scenario-quality decision

public_gates: M2429 must audit M2428 result_class and aggregate_by_candidate outcomes
M2429 must classify offtrack-dominated matched-subset evidence
M2429 must preserve c04 exclusion and source-coverage blocker
M2429 must choose branch synthesis, source-coverage repair, scenario-quality reassessment, bounded next evidence, or stop
M2429 must not rerun measured rollout, repair, train, rank candidates, select winners, or make verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not treat c04 as measured
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits matched-subset measured reindex and decides whether the branch has reached a scenario-quality/local-search decision point
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no new measured rollout, repair execution, training, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if the audit ranks c01/c02/c03 as winners
stop if the audit hides offtrack-dominated evidence
stop if the audit treats c04 as measured
stop if the audit routes to another artifact-only local-search step without new evidence or synthesis
fallback_plan: route to branch synthesis if matched-subset offtrack dominance and c04 exclusion make the next route ambiguous
route to source-coverage repair if c04 is judged essential for task-quality interpretation
route to scenario-quality reassessment if current-sim offtrack semantics are the dominant blocker
stop for user review if no bounded evidence-producing route is supported
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2428 produced measured reindex evidence after M2425 branch synthesis; synthesize if the next route is not clearly evidence-producing

admission_evidence: M2428 reindexed 5250 existing measured episodes into 13050 matched-family membership rows
M2428 aggregate_by_candidate has c01/c02/c03 all offtrack-dominated
M2428 excluded c04 from measured aggregates
M2428 did not rerun reset or measured rollout
allowed_updates: M2429 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: audit accepts or rejects M2428 explicitly
a bounded next route is selected or the branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2429 audits measured reindex outcomes and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2429; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If reindexed outcomes remain offtrack-dominated, record the negative result and choose synthesis/pivot/stop rather than more local artifact-only repair.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, candidate-family ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits a measured reindex that confirms matched-subset offtrack dominance without rerun
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can determine whether the current branch should synthesize or pivot; cannot establish current-sim or paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2429 cannot select a clear evidence-producing next route
c04 exclusion remains unresolved and matched subset remains offtrack-dominated

hypothesis: Auditing M2428 will determine whether the matched-subset offtrack-dominated result should trigger branch synthesis, c04 source-coverage repair, scenario-quality reassessment, or stop.
success_criteria: the audit accepts or rejects M2428 explicitly
a bounded non-ranking next route is selected or the branch is stopped
no measured rollout repair training ranking or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2429 ranks candidate families or selects a winner
M2429 makes measured improvement, current-sim, paper, FW-vs-GRU, or self-ID verdict claims
decision_rule: M2429 passes if it audits M2428 reindex evidence, preserves offtrack/c04 caveats, and selects a bounded non-ranking next route or stops without measured rollout, repair, training, ranking, or verdict claims.
